Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [1] “I am trying to understand given log generated by Spark Program” — Spark creates tasks per partition; transformations are evaluated when an action runs, and partition locality affects task placement.
2. [8] “Why does PySpark get stuck after completing few ShuffleMapTasks?” — Reports closely matching PySpark logs with HDFS input splits and `PythonRDD` timing entries while some shuffle tasks stop progressing; no confirmed cause or remediation was provided.
3. [16] “Simple RDD jobs take very long time to finish” — Shows PySpark task latency concentrated in `PythonRunner` boot time, while equivalent Scala work completes quickly, indicating Python-worker startup can dominate small tasks.

External Knowledge Summary:
- HDFS input-split and per-partition task messages are normal Spark execution logs.
- Similar PySpark stalls have occurred after only part of a shuffle stage completed, but the retrieved discussion provides no verified fix.
- `PythonRunner` timing can expose Python-worker startup overhead; however, negative `boot` values also appear in retrieved successful task logs and are not, by themselves, evidence of failure.
